tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background behind every panel. A cool shop-paper grey, never cream.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, finding cards, guide cards, form fields. The sheet the work happens on.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Source document panes (work instruction, veteran notes) and quote bodies.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All body text, headings, 2px control borders, selected tab fill. Reads on paper, surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Notes, source labels, step references, helper text. Reads on paper, surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: 1px hairline dividers and panel outlines. Never the only border on an interactive control: those use ink at 2px.

tokens.name: granite
tokens.usage: The header band, named for the granite surface plate parts are measured on.

tokens.name: on-granite
tokens.usage: Text and control borders on granite.

tokens.name: on-granite-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on granite, such as the demo-roles note.

tokens.name: dykem
tokens.usage: The one accent: primary buttons and links. Named for the blue layout fluid machinists paint on metal before scribing lines. Spend it on the next action only.

tokens.name: on-dykem
tokens.usage: Text on a dykem fill.

tokens.name: dykem-tint
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed backgrounds for secondary buttons and quick-question rows.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 3px solid, 2px offset, on paper and surface.

tokens.name: focus-on-granite
tokens.usage: Focus ring for controls inside the granite header.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Background of quoted spans highlighted inside a source document. Text on it stays ink.

tokens.name: accept
tokens.usage: Accept tag: approved cards, verified quotes, answers from approved guidance. Text and 2px borders on accept-bg and surface.

tokens.name: accept-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind accept text.

tokens.name: hold
tokens.usage: Hold tag: expert-confirmed cards waiting on quality. Text and borders on hold-bg.

tokens.name: hold-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind hold text, and behind the sample-output banner text.

tokens.name: reject
tokens.usage: Reject tag: unverified quotes, out-of-scope answers, failed calls. Text and borders on reject-bg and surface.

tokens.name: reject-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind reject text.

tokens.name: hazard
tokens.usage: Hazard stripes only, alternating with hazard-ink, on the sample-output banner. Never behind text.

tokens.name: hazard-ink
tokens.usage: The dark stripe between hazard stripes. Fixed in both themes.

families.display: "IBM Plex Sans Condensed", "Arial Narrow", system-ui, sans-serif
families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Section titles: Find gaps, Review guide cards, Ask about WI-114.

styles.name: heading
styles.sample: Let the first part cool before measuring
styles.usage: Finding topics, card titles, answer headings.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase stamps: tags, finding types, tab labels, source labels. Always uppercase via the sp-label class.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Let the part cool to shop temperature before you measure the pocket.
styles.usage: Running text, answers, card steps. 16px minimum so phones don't zoom inputs.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Inline field names (Why it matters, Follow-up) and button text.

styles.name: note
styles.sample: Answers come only from approved guide cards.
styles.usage: Helper text and role notes, in ink-muted.

styles.name: quote
styles.sample: A 4 inch bracket that's maybe 40 degrees over shop temperature will read about two thousandths long.
styles.usage: Words quoted from a source document, and the source panes. Mono marks text the app did not write.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Dimensions, tolerances, step numbers, model IDs, card IDs. Tabular figures.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its stamp or chip.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons in a row, and between quick-question rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside padding of quotes, banners and tags.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding, page side gutter, gap between panels.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top of page under the header; the cover's grid step.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Everything by default: panels, buttons, fields, tabs, quotes. Shop paperwork has square corners.

tokens.name: radius-tag
tokens.usage: Inspection tags and verify stamps only.

tokens.name: radius-hole
tokens.usage: The punch hole on an inspection tag, and nothing else.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Panel outlines and dividers in rule.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, tabs, tags: ink, or the tag's own colour.

tokens.name: border-stamp
tokens.usage: Out-of-scope answers and unverified findings, dashed, in reject.

tokens.name: control-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything tappable. Apprentices use this with gloves off, on a phone, at the machine.

tokens.name: tab-height
tokens.usage: Height of the Compare / Review / Ask step tabs.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum line length for answers and card steps.
